case.summary: Transaction 3514030 ($77.07, in-person) was flagged by the real-time detection model with a risk score of 0.61 due to unusual billing region activity, despite normal graph centrality and a history of similar cleared cases. Because the risk score alone is not a verdict, the investigation utilized the customer's profile and transaction history as supporting evidence. To resolve the alert in accordance with bank policy, the system initiated a customer verification request (`VERIFY_WITH_CUSTOMER`) to determine the transaction's legitimacy. Following this step, if the customer confirms the transaction, policy rule R3 dictates a recommendation to `CLOSE_NO_FRAUD`; if denied, rule R2 requires card blocking and case creation.
